name: NLI4VolVis Pipeline
aliases: Natural Language Interaction for Volume Visualization via LLM Multi-Agents and Editable 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: A framework integrating multi-view semantic segmentation, 3D open-vocabulary scene understanding, editable Gaussian training, and NLI for VolVis to enable natural language-driven interaction with volumetric datasets.
summary: NLI4VolVis is a framework enabling natural language interaction with volumetric data by decomposing scenes into editable 3D Gaussian components and using 2D stylization to avoid artifacts.
